about.title: About the Paldea Evolved set
paragraphs: Pokémon TCG: Paldea Evolved is a Scarlet & Violet expansion released on 9 June 2023. It has 279 cards: 193 in the main set and 86 secret rares. For a master set there are also 176 reverse holos, and 26 special prints from other products and events.

Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 193 main set cards), the Complete set (all 279 cards), the Master set (455 cards, adding every reverse holos) or the Grand Master set (481 cards, adding the 26 special prints (stamped, Cosmos Holo and other product-exclusive cards)).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
